mechanism: Clotrimazole inhibits CYP3A4, potentially increasing betamethasone systemic exposure and corticosteroid effects, particularly when betamethasone is systemically absorbed.
action: Monitor for signs of corticosteroid excess (hyperglycemia, hypertension, immunosuppression); consider dose adjustment or alternative antifungal if systemic betamethasone is used concurrently with clotrimazole.
